verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair ask for a meeting-notes product, but the evidence shows no user-configurable schedule for jobs or workflows. Recipes are reusable prompts run on demand with a click. Chat workflows, follow-up email drafts and HubSpot sync are one-off or event-triggered actions, not recurring schedules. Overnight pre-meeting briefs and transcript auto-deletion are fixed built-in behaviors, and Zapier is an external tool; none of these count as user-scheduled jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
